shots.say: How can Milo see under the deep blue sea? Look! His friend Tula lives down there!
shots.tag: hook: Milo looks down at Tula

shots.say: The Animated Zoo!
Hello, I'm Milo! Today I am at the sea, on my little rock.
Hello, Milo! I am going home now. My home is deep under the water.
shots.tag: Tula: my home is under the water

shots.say: Under the water? Oh, I want to see your home, Tula!
shots.tag: Milo: I want to see your home

shots.say: Then come along, Milo! Dive down with me!
Oh no. I am a little bird. I need air to breathe! I cannot go under the water.
Can Milo go under the water? Yes, or no?
shots.tag: question: under the water yes or no

shots.say: So Tula dives down, down, into the deep blue sea. And Milo stays on his rock.
I will find a way to see under the sea. I will try!
First, Milo looks down from his rock. He looks, and looks, and looks.
shots.tag: Milo looks down from his rock

shots.say: But the water is too deep. All he can see is the sun, twinkling on the waves.
What can Milo see from his rock? Tula's home, or twinkles?
Next, Milo finds a big green leaf. It floats, like a little boat!
shots.tag: a big green leaf floats in

shots.say: A leaf boat! Now I can sail out, and peek down.
But the leaf goes round, and round, and round. Milo gets so dizzy!
shots.tag: the leaf goes round and round

shots.say: Flap, flap! Milo flies back to his rock. The leaf boat did not help.
shots.tag: Milo flies back to his rock

shots.say: Did the leaf boat help Milo? Yes, or no?
shots.tag: question: did the leaf boat help

shots.say: Then Milo calls, as loud as he can. Tula! Tula! Can you hear me?
But far below, in the deep blue water, Tula swims along. She does not hear Milo at all.
shots.tag: Tula deep down does not hear

shots.say: Where is Tula now? Up at the top, or deep down?
shots.tag: question: at the top or deep down

shots.say: Milo sits down on his rock. He tried, and tried, and he still cannot see Tula's home.
Maybe a little bird can never see under the sea.
How does Milo feel now? Happy, or sad?
Then, look! Little bubbles pop up, right beside the rock.
Let's count the bubbles! One, two, three!
And up comes Tula! She takes a big, big breath of air.
Tula! You came back up! Why did you come up?
shots.tag: Milo: why did you come up

shots.say: I came up to breathe, Milo. I need air, just like you!
Sea turtles breathe air. They must come up to the surface to breathe.
What does a sea turtle breathe? Air, or water?
Can you take a big breath, like me? Breathe in, and blow it out!
I have an idea! I cannot go down. But you come up!
Every time you come up for air, tell me one thing you saw!
shots.tag: Milo: tell me one thing you saw

shots.say: So Tula dives down to the coral garden. It is pink, and orange, and purple!
Milo! I saw a coral garden. Pink, and orange, and purple!
Wow! I can see it in my head!
shots.tag: Milo sees the coral in his head

shots.say: Sea turtles cannot breathe under the water. But they can hold their breath for a long time.
shots.tag: fact: they hold their breath a long time

shots.say: Can a sea turtle hold her breath for a long time? Yes, or no?
shots.tag: question: hold her breath yes or no

shots.say: Next, Tula dives down to the seagrass meadow. The tall green grass waves hello!
Milo! I saw a seagrass meadow. It waves like a big green field!
Green and wavy! Tell me more, Tula!
shots.tag: Milo sees the seagrass in his head

shots.say: Then Tula dives down to the big rocks. Here is her cozy bed!
shots.tag: the big rocks: her cozy bed

shots.say: A sleeping sea turtle can stay under the water for several hours.
shots.tag: fact: a sleeping sea turtle stays under for hours

shots.say: Where is Tula's cozy bed? Under the water, or in a tree?
shots.tag: question: under the water or in a tree

shots.say: And I saw my cozy bed, by the big rocks!
Now I know your whole home, Tula! And I did not get wet at all!
shots.tag: Milo: I know your whole home

shots.say: Down I dive in the deep blue sea. Up I come, take a breath with me!
Did Milo find a way to see Tula's home? Yes, or no?
shots.tag: question: did Milo find a way

shots.say: The sun goes down, and the sea turns gold. Milo and Tula rest, side by side.
Thank you, Tula! You showed me your home, one breath at a time.
And you had the good idea, Milo. Friends can share in many ways!
When one way does not work, you can look for another way.
Do you remember? What does a sea turtle breathe? Air, or sand?
And where does a sea turtle go to breathe? Up to the top, or down to the sand?
Down she dives in the deep blue sea. Up she comes, for a breath with me!
See you on the next adventure, friends!
The Animated Zoo!
